_description: Critical startup programs that should NOT be disabled. StartupManager warns if the user selects these.

entries.name: Realtek Audio
entries.description: Audio driver control panel. Disabling may cause audio to stop working.

entries.name: NVIDIA Display Driver
entries.description: GPU driver service. Disabling breaks display output and GPU acceleration.

entries.name: AMD Radeon Software
entries.description: AMD GPU driver software. Disabling may cause display issues.

entries.name: Windows Security
entries.description: Windows Defender system tray icon. Disabling hides security notifications.

entries.name: Bluetooth Support
entries.description: Bluetooth stack. Disabling prevents Bluetooth devices from connecting.

entries.name: Intel Graphics Command Center
entries.description: Intel GPU driver service. Disabling may cause display scaling issues.

entries.name: Synaptics Touchpad
entries.description: Touchpad driver. Disabling removes touchpad gestures and configuration.

entries.name: Logitech G HUB
entries.description: Peripheral driver software. Disabling may reset custom key/button mappings.

entries.name: Windows Audio
entries.description: Core audio service. Disabling removes all system sound.

entries.name: Antivirus Software
entries.description: Third-party antivirus. Disabling leaves the system unprotected.
